verdict.rationale: Clerky handles document signing for its legal paperwork workflows, so this e-signature axis applies. However, the evidence only says users 'sign documents on Clerky' and that 'Clerky handles signing.' Nothing documents configurable signing order, automatic reminders, or expirations on outstanding signature requests.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can set signing order, automatic reminders, and expirations on outstanding signature requests
